title: 2022 CODATA: proton mag. shielding correction is 2.567 15 × 10^−5
summary: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, gives proton mag. shielding correction as 2.567 15 × 10^−5, with uncertainty 0.000 41 × 10^−5.
body: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, gives proton mag. shielding correction as 2.567 15 × 10^−5, with uncertainty 0.000 41 × 10^−5. The row is not marked exact. The uncertainty is the uncertainty printed on that row. The ASCII file does not split it into statistical and systematic parts. This is the proton magnetic shielding correction in the 2022 adjustment. It is not the shielded proton moment itself.
